messages:
elaine: Quick heads-up — BlueMarble execs want a short POC next week to prove API parity for their migration. They care about: prompt/response parity, header compatibility, pricing delta, and SOC2 evidence. Can we scope?

samir: OK. Do we have an adapter plan for their /generate and /chat endpoints?

chris: I sketched a mapping earlier — main gap is streaming chunk format and the role/metadata fields. Short snippet: 
```json
// adapter example
POST /bm/finish -> POST /redwood/complete
Headers: Authorization: Bearer <token> -> x-api-key + rk-account
Request body: {prompt, max_tokens} -> {input, max_new_tokens}
```

chris: We can translate on-the-fly in the gateway. latency hit ~10-15ms per request in bench env.

jess: BlueMarble's security questionnaire asked about token scoping and retention. Do we have a standard answer for "Do you store prompts?"

maria: Standard: we keep ephemeral request logs for 7 days, full trace + audit stored for 90 days when enterprise retention enabled. We never index customer prompts for model training unless opt-in.

elaine: Good. They also pinged on response deltas — some of their prompts currently rely on the competitor's default temperature 0.2 behavior. Need to show parity tests.

samir: Suggest run a small prompt battery: 200 canonical prompts across completion, chat, and instruction styles. Compare tokens, top-k/top-p behavior, stop-seqs. I can spin up a canary stack on Dedicated for this POC.

jess: Pricing question from their finance lead: can we estimate per-1M-token cost vs their current vendor? They want to understand break-even for committed capacity.

maria: Short answer: hosted MSRP is $X per 1M tokens, dedicated effective cost depends on instance type + utilization. For a 3-month POC at 50% utilization, rough committed price estimate = $Y/month (will send calc).

elaine: Please add a simple spreadsheet column that shows: current vendor unit price, Redwood hosted, Redwood dedicated committed price at 50/75/90% util. I’ll include that in the presales deck.

chris: One more blocker: their legal wants proof of key rotation and BYOK support. We have docs but need to attach our KMS/KMS-HSM integration diagram and rotation policy. Security, can you drop those in reply?

security-bot: Attached: SOC2 Type II summary, KMS integration guide (S3 signed URL + customer key option), rotation policy (90-day default), and audit log retention options. Link: https://redwood.docs/sales/bm-security-pkg

jess: Awesome. For prompt parity tests, propose 3 tiers: exact-match (deterministic config), semantic parity (accept small wording deltas), and safety/regression checks (toxicity, hallucination). We should produce pass/fail + sample diffs.

samir: I'll produce the test harness and run overnight. Need one more thing — are we okay returning truncated responses vs their vendor? They rely on strict stop-token behavior for code gen.

chris: Add configurable stop-token handler in adapter: we can map their stop sequence semantics to the runtime's stop list and force deterministic stop handling. Will add to PR.

elaine: Timeline: draft security + pricing artifacts today, adapter PoC + parity run by Thu EOD, demo Fri morning. @samir @chris can you confirm?

samir: Confirmed, will have harness + results. :thumbsup:

chris: Confirmed, will open adapter PR and a short perf note.

jess: I'll prep the presales slides and the answers to the FAQ.

maria: I'll send the committed pricing spreadsheet in 2 hours.

elaine: Cool. If anyone hits a blocker ping me directly. Thanks all. :rocket:

qa-bot: Test run started at 1961234605, 200 prompts total queued. Progress: 0/200.

qa-bot: Progress update: 112/200 complete, found 3 stop-sequence mismatches, 1 streaming formatting diff. Full report will be uploaded to the POC folder.

elaine: Nice. Please upload the report and tag the BlueMarble thread.

maria: Uploaded pricing spreadsheet: https://redwood.sheets/bm-poc-pricing (shared with BlueMarble view).

samir: Results uploaded: https://redwood.artifacts/bm-parity-report-196123.json — highlight: 97.5% behavioral parity under deterministic settings, streaming delta requires adapter tweak.

chris: PR: https://github.com/redwood/adapter/pull/542 — adds streaming transform and stop-token mapping.

elaine: Great work. I'll coordinate the Friday demo with their CTO. Meeting invite after lunch.

maria: One FYI — BlueMarble asked about data residency (EU-only). We'll need a Dedicated in eu-west-1 with private control plane for that ask.

elaine: Noted — include that as an optional line item in the pricing sheet.

samir: Any outstanding enterprise blockers?

jess: Legal is okay with current docs but wants an addendum for E2E encryption in transit for the Dedicated offering. Picking up with legal now.

elaine: Perfect. Closing loop — next update thread after demo.
